lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Health and lifestyle (symptom, injury, recover, treatment, prescription, check-up, allergic, stress, nutrition, burnout).

head: Palavra
Significado
Exemplo
rows: A high temperature is a common symptom of flu.
He missed the match because of a knee injury.
She is recovering from an operation.
The treatment lasts about six weeks.
The doctor gave me a prescription for antibiotics.
I have a check-up every year.
Too much stress can affect your sleep.
Good nutrition is important for athletes.
One side effect is a dry mouth.
I was exhausted after the night shift.

items: **make / book** an appointment; **have / get** a check-up
**take** medicine, a pill, a test; **have** surgery
**suffer from** stress, back pain; **recover from** an illness
**catch** a cold; **come down with** the flu; **get over** an illness
"I drank the medicine." Remédio se **toma**: **I took the medicine.**
"I'm with a headache." O certo é **I have a headache.**
"I did a surgery last year." O paciente **had** surgery: **I had surgery last year.**
"Stress" é incontável: **I have a lot of stress** (não *stresses*).

I'm ___ to peanuts, so I can't eat that cake.
Please ___ an appointment with the dentist.
I drank the medicine this morning.

acc: I had a surgery last year

lessons.title: Modais no passado
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: modais no passado (should have, could have, might have, must have, can't have, needn't have).

head: Estrutura
Sentido
Exemplo
rows: era a coisa certa, mas não foi feita (arrependimento, crítica)
I should have gone to the doctor earlier.
You shouldn't have eaten so much.
She could have won, but she was injured.
He might have caught a cold at the gym.
tenho quase certeza de que aconteceu
tenho quase certeza de que NÃO aconteceu
She can't have known about it.
We needn't have hurried. The doctor was late.

items: Depois de qualquer modal vem **have + particípio**. Nunca o passado simples: *should have gone*, não *should went*.
**needn't have done** (fez sem precisar) é diferente de **didn't need to do** (não precisava e talvez nem tenha feito).
Na fala, **have** vira /əv/: *should've, could've, must've*. Não escreva *should of*.
"I should went to the doctor." O certo é **I should have gone.**
"He must had forgotten." O certo é **He must have forgotten.**
"She could has called me." O certo é **She could have called me.**
"You should of told me." O certo é **You should have told me.**

exercises.prompt: I feel terrible. I ___ (not stay) up so late.
He didn't answer. He ___ (be) asleep.
She ___ (win) the race, but she fell.
We took umbrellas, but it didn't rain. We ___ (bring) them.
I should went to the doctor earlier.
acc: I should have gone to the doctor earlier

exercises.prompt: He must had forgotten the appointment.
acc: He must have forgotten the appointment

exercises.prompt: You should of told me about the side effects.
acc: You should have told me about the side effects

lessons.title: Inglês prático, dar conselho com tato
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Dar conselho com tato.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: Can I give you some advice? / I don't want to interfere, but...
You might want to... / It might be a good idea to... / Have you thought about...?
If I were you, I'd see a doctor. / Why don't you take a few days off?
That sounds really tough. / I understand how you feel.
It could help you to sleep better. / It's worth trying.
That's a good idea, thanks. / I'll think about it.

items: "You must to rest." Depois de modal não há **to**: **You should rest.**
"I want to give you a good advice." **Advice** é incontável: **some good advice** ou **a good piece of advice.**
"You have to see a doctor!" soa muito duro. Prefira **You might want to see a doctor.**

exercises.prompt: If I ___ you, I'd see a doctor.
You ___ want to take a few days off.
Have you ___ about asking for help?
I don't want to ___, but I think you should rest.
You must to rest more.
I want to give you a good advice.
acc: I want to give you some good advice
I want to give you a good piece of advice
I want to give you good advice
